blocks.text: The rest of the roll — bridges, gates, and a maison de retraite.

01-saint-cloud.jpg.title: Saint-Cloud
01-saint-cloud.jpg.alt: Saint-Cloud: an open-access photograph from the National Gallery of Art.
01-saint-cloud.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Cloud, 1926. National Gallery of Art.

02-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.title: Parc de Sceaux
02-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.alt: This sepia-toned photograph shows a long, grassy path that extends into the distance.
02-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Parc de Sceaux, 1925. National Gallery of Art.

03-saint-cloud.jpg.title: Saint-Cloud
03-saint-cloud.jpg.alt: The image shows a landscape with a large tree, a stone statue of a figure with a cross, distant leafless trees, a reflective body of water, and a misty horizon.
03-saint-cloud.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Cloud, 1926. National Gallery of Art.

04-nympheas.jpg.title: Nymphéas
04-nympheas.jpg.alt: The view is from above and slightly to the side, showing water-lilies and surrounding details on a pond.
04-nympheas.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Nymphéas, 1922/1923. National Gallery of Art.

05-arcueil-cachan-parc-de-madame-de-prov.title: Arcueil-Cachan, Parc de Madame de Provigny
05-arcueil-cachan-parc-de-madame-de-prov.alt: The image shows a grassy area with scattered sticks, logs, and a stone structure in the foreground.
05-arcueil-cachan-parc-de-madame-de-prov.description: Eugène Atget. Arcueil-Cachan, Parc de Madame de Provigny, 1901. National Gallery of Art.

06-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.title: Nymphéas (Bagatelle)
06-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.alt: This sepia-toned photograph displays a pond with lily pads and water lilies.
06-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Nymphéas (Bagatelle), 1925. National Gallery of Art.

01-saint-cloud.jpg.title: Saint-Cloud
01-saint-cloud.jpg.alt: The image depicts a park landscape with a tree and a statue close to the viewer.
01-saint-cloud.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Cloud, 1926. National Gallery of Art.

02-pont-marie.jpg.title: Pont Marie
02-pont-marie.jpg.alt: The image shows a ground-level perspective of an arched stone bridge spanning horizontally across the scene.
02-pont-marie.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Pont Marie, 1926. National Gallery of Art.

03-poterne-des-peupliers.jpg.title: Poterne des Peupliers
03-poterne-des-peupliers.jpg.alt: The image shows a low angle view of a steep, rocky slope with two rustic buildings on top.
03-poterne-des-peupliers.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Poterne des Peupliers, 1913. National Gallery of Art.

04-saint-denis-maison-de-retraite.jpg.title: Saint-Denis, maison de retraite
04-saint-denis-maison-de-retraite.jpg.alt: This is a photograph of an arched underground cellar or basement with laundry hanging.
04-saint-denis-maison-de-retraite.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Denis, maison de retraite, 1901. National Gallery of Art.
